metaTitle: Corporate flowers and gifting in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah
metaDescription: Weekly and monthly office flower programs, corporate gifts and event decor with tax invoices showing your TRN and PO number. Delivery across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah.
title: Fresh flowers for the places your team works
lead: Weekly and monthly flower programs for reception, boardrooms and lobbies, plus corporate gifts, with tax invoices that show your TRN and purchase-order number.

programs.title: Weekly and monthly programs
programs.body: The same day each week, a fresh arrangement arrives before you open and last week's leaves.

gifting.title: Corporate gifting
gifting.body: Client thank-yous, executive gifts and festive hampers, one at a time or in bulk.

events.title: Event decor
events.body: Entrances, centrepieces and stage florals for launches, dinners and conferences.

estimatorBody: Choose an arrangement and a term to see the full cost, including VAT and the refundable vase deposit, before you talk to anyone.
estDeliveries: {count, plural, one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}} at {price} each
estDepositNote: The deposit is not subject to VAT and is returned when the vases are collected.

1.title: Tax invoice with your TRN
1.body: Add your company name, TRN and PO number at checkout. VAT at 5% is shown separately.

2.title: One invoice a month
2.body: Programs are invoiced monthly, not delivery by delivery.

3.title: Deposit outside VAT
3.body: Vase deposits are listed separately, refundable and not part of the VAT base.

4.title: Clear terms
4.body: Minimum terms, cut-offs and pause notice are stated before you commit.

1.title: Tell us the space
1.body: Reception, boardroom or lobby, and the day you want delivery.

2.title: Confirm the arrangement
2.body: We match your palette and confirm the quote and the first delivery date.

3.title: We deliver weekly
3.body: Fresh flowers arrive before you open and last week's leave.

4.title: Pause or change
4.body: Seven days' notice to pause, resize or change the arrangement.

giftingBody: Singly or in bulk, with a printed card and one tax invoice.
quoteBody: Tell us what you need and where. We reply with a quote, usually within one working day.
